texts.title: The Commons March
texts.body: The square below {self.name}'s windows is full and it is not a feast day. The commons of {self.house}'s worlds have a petition and a grievance — the tithe, the levies, the courts, the labour laws — and they have brought both to the gate.

choices.hear_the_petition: Go down and hear the petition read to the end.
choices.bread_and_a_holiday: Declare a holiday and pay for the bread. Eight credits.
choices.clear_the_square: Have the guard clear the square.

texts.title: The Merchants' Delegation
texts.body: The factors of {self.house}'s worlds have sent a delegation, and they have brought their ledgers. The tariffs, the tolls, the labour law — something the house has set is costing them, and they have closed the warehouses to say so.

choices.a_concession: A concession on the customs house. Four credits of duty.
choices.show_them_the_law: Read them the law and show them the door.

texts.title: The Officers' Grievance
texts.body: The wardroom has drafted a letter, and the admiral has quietly let {self.name} see it before it is sent. The officers of {self.house}'s hulls want a guard kept, pay that arrives, and a house that values the men who crew its guns.

choices.dine_the_wardroom: Dine the wardroom and listen. Five credits.
choices.promote_the_loudest: Promote the loudest of them over an old-blood captain.
choices.remind_them_who_pays: Remind them who pays for the hulls.

texts.title: The Old Blood's Letter
texts.body: A letter signed by the oldest houses of the Reach, in the oldest form, regrets that {self.house} has set aside the customs a house of standing should keep — an open hall, an open ballot, courts too lenient, a franchise too wide. It is copied to the Senate.

choices.a_ceremony: A ceremony of the old form, with the old houses in the old order. Six credits.
choices.let_them_write: Let them write. The commons like a house the old blood dislikes.

texts.title: The Magistrates' Find
texts.body: The magistrates of {self.house}'s worlds, who approve of how the house keeps its law, have found six credits the collectors missed, and bring them to {self.name} with a bow and a question in their eyes.

choices.return_it: Send it back to the worlds it came from.

texts.title: The Frontier Rides In
texts.body: A delegation of belt-rats and free-company captains has come in from the rim to tell {self.name}, loudly, what the march law and the patrols are costing the people who live on the lanes. They have not come to be told no.

choices.ease_the_patrols: Ease the patrols for a season.
choices.hang_a_few: Hang a few of the loudest. Ruthless.
choices.buy_them_a_drink: Stand them a night's drinking. Three credits.

texts.title: The Exiles
texts.body: A ship of exiles has come in from a rival's worlds — commons who have had enough of a harsher tithe, a harder labour law, a court with no mercy — asking {self.house} for a berth. The port is full of them, and of opinions about them.

choices.take_them_in: Take them in. Hands for the yards, grumbling for a season.
choices.turn_them_back: Turn them back at the port.
